content: Electron cross-platform gaps for a tray app: globalShortcut has a long-standing macOS bug with non-QWERTY layouts and can silently fail to register without Accessibility trust; Tray needs setAutosaveName (Electron 38+) to keep menu-bar position across launches on macOS and should use template images for light/dark adaptation; Notification silently no-ops under macOS Do Not Disturb with no error; tray-only apps should call app.dock.hide() on darwin to avoid an unwanted Dock icon.
